title: Arop-Lokep language
text: Arop-Lokep is characterized by two primary dialects: Arop (also known as Poonoo) and Lokep (also known as Lokewe). The Arop dialect is spoken primarily on Long Island in Madang Province, Papua New Guinea, by approximately 1,800 speakers.
